name: Postmodern architecture

influenced_by: a reaction against modernist and Brutalist architecture's severity
Pop Art's embrace of commercial imagery

places: varied; a genuinely international, media-driven movement
garments: not a specific fashion look, though it fed the deliberately clashing color and pattern of 1980s design broadly

media.title: Charles Jencks, The Language of Post-Modern Architecture (1977)
media.note: the book that named and defined the movement

reacts_against: modernism's "less is more" austerity, reintroducing color, historical ornament and irony on purpose.

findings: light — about 80% of the measured color is pale or near-white
mostly muted — about 87% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
